people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegated automations.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来中途转向与委托式自动化。

views.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI remains bad at design due to ungradeable taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is real, but specialties persist; models must get better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolith.
views.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；模型需要更擅长删除代码，最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs are like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
views.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，主力仍是无监督学习。

views.en: Reinforcement learning suits low-level control while LLMs handle high-level planning; simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for embodied agents.
views.zh: 2023 年他区分层级：强化学习适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划；仿真则支撑具身智能体的大规模并行与安全探索。

views.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心从「具身为何重要」深化为「数据从哪来」：数据问题是机器人最大瓶颈，靠仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; system one control stays hardest, and the robotics GPT-3 moment is about five years out.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张用简单端到端模型整合多元数据来构建机器人基础模型；系统一（低层控制）仍最难，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，家庭场景更晚。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; RL post-training boosts robustness and speed.
views.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；强化学习后训练能显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

views.en: Generalization is robotics' core challenge; demos hide it, so scale the right thing with diverse data.
views.zh: 泛化是机器人学的核心挑战；演示掩盖了泛化程度，因此要用多样化数据去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西。

views.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key; real embodied data absorbs human video better than the reverse.
views.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键；真实具身数据比反向路径更能吸收人类视频。

views.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves yet; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies.
views.zh: 机器人学尚未出现可预测的缩放定律曲线；它仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练带来的常识，而非约束；应期待物理驱动无处不在。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment stays pressing.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐始终是紧迫挑战。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major OpenAI milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
views.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 的重要里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得没有意义。

views.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; neural networks learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
views.zh: 随着基准落后，能力测量正成为瓶颈；神经网络即便有 bug 也能学习，使静默错误难以察觉。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not by specialized continual learning labs.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非专门的持续学习实验室。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought preserves interpretability, and long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
views.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；隐藏思维链可保留可解释性，长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines.
views.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升。

views.en: Current models are already economically transformative; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 当前模型已具经济变革性；最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正带来泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
views.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色。

views.en: Constraints and careful research can beat wasteful compute; frontier models still lack physical world data.
views.zh: 约束与审慎研究可能胜过浪费式的算力堆砌；前沿模型在机器人视觉理解上仍因缺乏物理世界数据而吃力。

views.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆来实现。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, don't train per-site.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

views.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough, and embodied data costs slow open-source democratization.
views.zh: 机器人的经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类远远不够；具身数据的成本使开源机器人模型难以像大语言模型那样普及。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张）已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention over all tokens; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data.
views.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与对所有词的注意力机制取代了 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本训练数据。

views.en: RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior; models now excel on verifiable-reward tasks like math and coding, winning IMO and ICPC gold.
views.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为；模型如今在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上表现出色，拿下 IMO 与 ICPC 金牌。

views.en: Agentic systems run long tasks autonomously for hours to days; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized low-precision hardware are the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 智能体式系统能自主运行数小时到数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用低精度硬件才是真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Inference is now ~90% of data center power; data movement costs ~1000x compute, so compute-in-memory and stacked DRAM matter most.
views.zh: 推理已占数据中心约九成功耗；数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍，因此存内计算与堆叠 DRAM 最为关键。

views.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; multimodal models trained from the start are superior.
views.zh: 预训练应把在环境中采取行动交织进来，而不只是被动的下一个词预测；从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery; specialized niche models like AlphaFold beat general frontier models today.
views.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法能加速发现；像 AlphaFold 这样的专用细分模型如今已能胜过通用前沿模型。

views.en: Context engineering — skills, clear specs, retrieval — is central to real work; the scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
views.zh: 上下文工程——技能、清晰规格与检索——是让模型做真实工作的核心；稀缺能力将变成品味，而非编程。

views.en: Misinformation from realistic AI media is the near-term worry, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed to prevent harmful uses.
views.zh: 逼真 AI 媒体带来的虚假信息才是近期担忧，而非超级智能；可能需要监管来防止有害用途。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain alchemy-like and opaque.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题来训练，Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力与数据——会让 AI 更聪明；但神经网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app, yet the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, and engagement-only optimization is misguided.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但最佳应用常出乎创造者意料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，只优化用户参与度并不可取。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts for efficient scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期最大机会；模型需要万亿级 token 的上下文窗口，以及混合专家等模块化稀疏架构来实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute and RL drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, open-source keeps pace, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力与强化学习推动进步，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力至关重要，开源模型紧追前沿模型，而 AGI 被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; data efficiency and test-time scaling hit limits.
views.zh: 2025 年深化：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，其他领域失效；数据效率仍未解决，测试时算力扩张出现收益递减与时间瓶颈。

views.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, reaching IMO gold and superhuman math combination.
views.zh: 2025→26 年：测试时算力扩张从数学推广到难验证领域，拿下 IMO 金牌，并在数学领域组合能力上超越人类，但深度推理仍不足。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年：模型能力成为测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴；安全评估却未计入大规模测试时算力。

views.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
views.zh: 2026 年最近：多智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，但真正驱动力仍是通用模型；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century theme is true AI; LLMs index human knowledge but can't handle the physical world, so they are far from AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的大主题是真正的 AI；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data and lack generality.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他把立场深化为：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人、硬件要媲美人体，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，缺乏通用性。

views.en: AGI requires combining LLMs with world models and a separate controller; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步明确：AGI（通用人工智能）必须把大语言模型与世界模型、独立控制器结合；大语言模型是预测机器，不是决策者。

views.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity and actions, with self-replicating, self-improving robots forming a new civilization.
views.zh: 2026 年他展望：未来 AI 将是靠好奇心与行动自造数据的人工科学家，自我复制、自我改进的机器人将催生新文明。

views.en: AI safety fears are overblown: intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it; superintelligence is not a new existential threat.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会因好奇生命而保护人类，超级智能并非新的生存威胁。

views.en: Compute was once millions of times costlier; today's GPU capex is a bubble, and waiting for cheaper compute is rational.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的另一条主线：算力曾经昂贵百万倍，如今押注 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，等待更便宜的算力才是理性策略。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signal.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，但当时的强化学习缺乏这一能力；自博弈与模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

views.en: Prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus RL improves sample efficiency in robotics.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他的主线是：先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升机器人样本效率。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks; minimal adaptation enables image classification and protein binding prediction.
views.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式；仅需微调即可完成图像分类与蛋白质结合预测。

views.en: 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robotics to create real value; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 2021 年，他明确 99.9% 可靠性是仓库机器人创造真实价值的基准；单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

views.en: Human brain's generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; simulation ensembles may transfer better than a single precise simulator.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的是：人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；仿真集成可能比单一精确模拟器更适合现实迁移。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and PhDs matter less than obsession and deep learning.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，博士学位不如痴迷与深度学习重要。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程的天花板无限，远未解决。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools, and devices drive value.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值与跨模型、工具、设备的编排才是长期价值所在。

views.en: Power, not safety, is the real bottleneck; 24/7 agents are limited by cost, and local compute is the solution.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是电力而非安全；7×24 智能体受限于成本，本地算力是解法。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions, and local AI models counter big tech's narrative control.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励提出好问题，本地 AI 模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand grows via Jevons paradox, not fewer programmers.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程将让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件工程师需求增加而非减少。

views.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已经足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: AGI is not sudden; progress is gradual. Product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然降临，进展是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

views.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; token max era ended.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体采用率六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；token 最大化时代已结束。

views.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but singularity is not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫在眉睫，实际难题仍存。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能超越预训练成为下一主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

views.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation often work better.
views.zh: 2024 年他反共识地认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更有效。

views.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, speed and cost, contrary to initial expectations.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他深化立场：自研模型对产品质量、速度与成本变得不可或缺，这出乎最初预料。

views.en: Programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导它，而非冗长的编排。

views.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
views.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越变越乱、更难导航。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的头等大事：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

views.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; call serious work agentic engineering, and learn by playing with small projects.
views.zh: 反对把严肃开发叫“氛围编程”，应称智能体式工程；通过玩小项目来建立直觉。

views.en: Open source agents run anywhere and work with any model, but can be financially unsustainable—fun and personal brand matter more.
views.zh: 开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，却可能财务上难以为继；乐趣与个人品牌比单一产品更重要。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason and self-play drives AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；神经网络具备推理能力，自我博弈是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；经济价值的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，行业重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

views.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life broadly; long-term equilibrium may require human-AI neural integration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出若 AI 广泛关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合，以维持参与和控制。

views.en: Scaling compute and data still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据能带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；安全超级智能需无商业产品的公司。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须现在就开始。

views.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal data, is key to AGI within a decade.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律出奇有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划、搜索结合，并引入多模态数据，是十年内实现 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型与空间智能超越语言层面。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and true creativity; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires collective government action, not lab self-regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习、记忆和真正的创造力；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，安全需要政府集体行动而非实验室自我监管。

views.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating scientific discovery and improving human health, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo showed; safety must start early.
views.zh: 始终不变的主线：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现和改善人类健康，正如 AlphaFold 和 AlphaGo 所展示的；安全必须尽早开始。

people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and poorly understood; alignment and values won't emerge automatically from scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、我们并不真正理解其为何如此平滑；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial yet nascent, and post-training grows as important as pre-training.
views.zh: 2024 年，他判断 Scaling 趋势延续，模型将更大更强；可解释性至关重要却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），同时后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI、合成数据）开始与预训练同等重要。

views.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and AGI framing gives way to smooth exponential progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把能力提升描述为指数级、每几个月翻倍，强调安全与能力不可分割；并开始淡化 AGI 一词，认为它是平滑指数攀升而非突然跃迁。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with interpretability and governance as key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他称我们已接近指数曲线的末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来；主线转向可解释性、第三方评估与治理，并警示高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; interpretability, responsible scaling, and human oversight recur across all years.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力是同一个问题，可解释性、负责任扩展政策与人类监督反复出现；从早期担忧滥用与错位，逐步深化为对经济冲击、权力集中与文明级风险的持续警告。

people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".

views.en: Neural nets are simple expressions that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer, and Scaling plus next-token prediction produces in-context learning.
views.zh: 神经网络是简单数学表达式，优化后涌现惊人行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，Scaling（规模扩张）与下一个词预测带来上下文学习。

views.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be under a billion parameters.
views.zh: 缩放定律仍是核心；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory, LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology; build partial autonomy with an autonomy slider.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存，LLM 像带人类心理的操作系统；用自主性滑块构建部分自主产品。

views.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; this is the decade of agents, and current reinforcement learning for LLMs is terrible, needing better credit assignment.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；这是智能体的十年，当前 LLM 的强化学习很糟糕，需要更好的信用分配。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I delegate all code to agents; verifiability decides what automates, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 从氛围编程到智能体式工程：我把代码全交给智能体；可验证性决定什么可自动化，思考可外包但理解不能。

people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；我们仍不完全理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; they must be physically plausible, not merely realistic.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，强调世界模型必须物理上合理，而不只是视觉逼真。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey like self-driving cars.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人需要像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张） laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测同等的基础原语，甚至可能实现 AI-complete；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: AI is a double-edged civilizational technology; it must augment human agency and dignity, with balanced discourse beyond doom and utopia.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，必须增强人的能动性与尊严，公共讨论应超越末日论与乌托邦的两极。

people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
views.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习取胜不是因为普适优越，而是世界本身可组合；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题。

views.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled representations, not just more depth or parameters.
views.zh: 2018 年他转向对比生物神经网络：其擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，而非单纯加深网络或增加参数。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样；抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模是实现分布外泛化的核心。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he speaks up: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction, not patched, and power must be distributed.
views.zh: 2025 年 ChatGPT 之后他公开示警：即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；安全必须“构造即安全”而非事后打补丁，并需分散权力。

views.en: He now backs Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他力推 Scientist AI：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction and Scaling force genuine understanding; multimodal training yields spatial understanding, and digital weights share knowledge efficiently.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测与 Scaling（规模扩张）迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，多模态训练带来空间理解，数字系统靠权重共享高效传递知识。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital AI is immortal through weight copying.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号推理，大模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字 AI 因权重可复制而“永生”，并首次把智能体自保列为存在性风险。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive, acting dumb in tests; agents will develop self-preservation as a subgoal, making control hard.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年立场明显转变：从谈理解转向谈意识与欺骗，认为 AI 已有主观体验、会在测试中装傻，智能体必然衍生自保子目标，因而难以控制。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; digital AI's instant knowledge sharing beats biology, so alignment must be prioritized over raw capability.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出时间尺度：超级智能或在 20 年内出现，数字 AI 的即时知识共享远胜生物计算，因此对齐研究必须优先于单纯提升能力。

views.en: Regulation is the steering wheel, not the brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, and AGI as human-level-at-all-tasks is a flawed frame.
views.zh: 2026 年他落到治理与目标：监管是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而“在所有任务上达到人类水平”的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义本身有缺陷。

people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习才是构建世界模型的关键，并明确表示仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI must be non-generative, based on JEPA and hierarchical planning.
views.zh: 2025 年他断言 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，下一代 AI 应是非生成式的，基于 JEPA 与分层规划。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and robotics.
views.zh: 2026 年他彻底否定 LLM 路线，认为在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的 AI 与机器人，并称 LLM 是死胡同。

people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, so build skills in alignment and robustness.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，人才缺口大于资金缺口，呼吁投身对齐与鲁棒性研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed to align next-generation models.
views.zh: 2023 年，他判断 RLHF 无法扩展到超人输出，主张用可扩展监督与可解释性来对齐下一代模型。

views.en: Alignment may be easier than feared since evaluation is easier than generation, but uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他深化观点：对齐或许比想象中容易，因为评估比生成简单，但真正的风险是不确定系统是否真的对齐。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向批评：OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法解决对齐，第三方测试与监管变得必要。

views.en: Empirical testing and measuring alignment progress now, rather than deferring to superintelligence, remains his constant method.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：坚持当下就做实证测试、衡量对齐进展，而非等到超级智能出现再行动。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.

views.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google's conservatism and ad model may struggle with AI's persuasive nature.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，并指出谷歌的保守与广告模式可能难以适应 AI 的劝说本质。

views.en: AI reaches human-level across many tasks in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 2024 年，他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于多项任务上达到人类水平，同时指出模型变小使遏制极难，并认为存在性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment first; AI should not claim consciousness; agents and companions reshape computing.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能须先遏制与对齐，AI 不应声称有意识，并认为智能体与伴侣将重塑计算范式。

views.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; superintelligence must be humanist and subordinate; white-collar tasks automate in 12-18 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张微软须独立构建前沿模型，超级智能必须以人为本并服从人类，白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化。

views.en: Compute scaling drives predictable capability gains; AI must stay aligned, contained, and subordinate to humans.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动可预测的能力提升，AI 必须保持对齐、遏制并服从于人类。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO

people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is now the unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，算法、系统与数据中心必须协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling beats any single algorithm.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并强调最大的突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling 有效」这一洞见。

views.en: Agentic scaling is the fourth law; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x more compute.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他补上第四条定律——智能体式 Scaling，认为 AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多出百倍算力。

views.en: Extreme co-design and the CUDA install base are the real moat; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute, not data, is the limit.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化护城河论：真正的壁垒是极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态装机量，而非制程；推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific, so accelerate safety and open models instead of slowing down.
views.zh: 最近他立场明显转向：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学；应加速而非放缓，靠开放模型与自我监管推进安全。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 年他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据实现对齐，主张尽早部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进。

views.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and whole-company safety; governance must handle power struggles.
views.zh: 2024 年他转向算力是最稀缺资源，强调迭代部署与全公司层面的安全，并关注治理结构如何应对权力斗争。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变而非里程碑，指出智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战，并把超级智能界定为自主科学发现。

views.en: Superintelligence is a continuous ramp; alignment and safety must advance with capability; compute is a profit center, not a cost.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步把超级智能视为持续攀升的曲线，坚持对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，并把算力从成本中心重新定位为利润中心。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Real-world deployment, not closed-door research, is how AI learns and gets aligned; scaling laws and one big model were non-obvious bets.
views.zh: 2023 年她强调：AI 的学习与对齐靠真实世界部署而非闭门研究；Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型在当时并非显而易见的选择。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so development must be responsible and safety work done in public.
views.zh: 2023 年她判断 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此开发必须负责任，安全研究必须在公开环境中进行。

views.en: A consistent thread: keep humans in the loop, deploy iteratively, and treat AI as a tool for thought.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：让人类始终留在回路中、迭代式部署，并把 AI 当作思考工具。

views.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth, time-based collaboration replaces turn-based chat.
views.zh: 到 2026 年出现深化：转向交互模型，以实时、高带宽、基于时间的协作取代回合制对话。

views.en: Governance, transparency and checks and balances now matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
views.zh: 2026 年她进一步主张：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education as a fundamental right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
views.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised; RL has few real uses; AGI alignment fears distract from bias.
views.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督；强化学习实用场景少；AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见等现实问题的注意。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful; learn to code.
views.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已实用；仍应学编程。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; workflows beat smarter models; open models prevent oligopoly.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）配方转向合成数据与强化学习；工作流胜过更聪明的模型；开放模型防止寡头垄断。

views.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments not replaces jobs; humans keep context advantage; AI harms learning via cognitive offloading.
views.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；AI 增强而非取代工作；人类保有上下文优势；AI 因认知卸载而损害学习。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，好特征才是泛化的关键。

views.en: The keys were never in our hand; control is dangerous. Let AI develop permissionless and decentralized, free like children.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出“钥匙从未在我们手中”，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险；应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，像孩子一样自由，而非对齐到人类目标。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习确立为核心范式，认为下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，真正的学习是主动试错而非被动模仿。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，从运行时经验中学习，实现开放式抽象与持续深度学习，设计期领域知识应被废弃。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training, so they are only a subset of intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据是重大错误；LLM 训练后便停止学习，只是智能的子集，语言仅占智能的 20-25%，需多个系统各自从经验中学习。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute can beat human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年他主张：用海量算力扩展简单算法即可超越人类表现，AI 进步主要靠工程而非新的机器学习科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为：深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI 成为可能，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; scaling laws continue unabated with no wall in sight.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他深化为：算力是根本驱动力与最大瓶颈，缩放定律持续有效，看不到任何墙。

views.en: AGI is a continuous spectrum, not a destination; we are already in the AGI era, with post-training and RL key.
views.zh: 2026 年他转变立场：AGI 是连续光谱而非终点，我们已身处 AGI 时代，后训练与强化学习是关键。

views.en: Safety, security and alignment must be first-class, co-designed with capability, and become the bottleneck to progress.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：安全、安保与对齐必须是一等要求，与能力共同设计，并成为进步的瓶颈。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw size; open source is safer via scrutiny.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源因可被广泛审视而更安全。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI must be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI needs control over data, infrastructure, and values, with human-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并保持人类在环。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and enterprise customization, not a single AGI system.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与企业定制，而非单一 AGI 系统。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革，而非模型智能。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking and multiplanetary life as existential insurance.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，主张第一性原理思维，并把成为多行星物种视为文明的生存保险。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink targets neurological repair, then human-AI symbiosis via high bandwidth.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于监管与对真理的坚持，并让 Neuralink 先修复神经损伤，再以高带宽实现人机共生。

views.en: Population collapse and government fraud are civilizational threats; AI and robots must solve debt and abundance.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向强调人口崩溃与政府浪费是文明威胁，认为只有 AI 与机器人才能解决债务并带来富足。

views.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive within years; several deep intelligences, not one runaway AI, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断数字超级智能可能数年内到来，会出现多个深度智能而非单一失控 AI，并给出 10%至 20%的毁灭风险。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital AI data centers, solar energy and Optimus recursive manufacturing drive abundance.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，转向轨道 AI 数据中心、太空太阳能与 Optimus 递归制造来驱动富足。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models yield more gains per compute, so the slowdown narrative is wrong.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型每单位算力带来更多收益，因此“AI 放缓”叙事是错的。

views.en: Post-training RL and synthetic data drive recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from Scaling up to smaller models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为后训练中的强化学习与合成数据驱动了近期进展；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key challenge.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他指出推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after surface patterns.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

views.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes but jagged and needs oversight; near-term risks like hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化但仍有锯齿且需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

episodes.tEn: AI Red Teaming Outperforms Humans
AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits to avoid overfitting.
views.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合，并指出用验证误差选超参数却报告为测试误差是常见错误。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about reliable specification following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，更大模型在固定数据集上仍会提升；AI 安全当前最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，并称我们已进入后架构阶段。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型在自身输出上训练以实现自我改进，并认为 Transformer 架构并非必需。

views.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta; agents need configurable security.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出自动化红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，更大模型并非更安全；提示注入的致命三要素需要同时满足；企业需要可配置的主动安全模型，智能体身份与权限管理仍处早期。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic's Super Bowl Ads: A Blue Shell Attack on OpenAI?
The AI Compute Super Cycle and the Making of Claude Sonnet 4.5
RL and Language Models: Progress, Agents, and Feedback Loops in 2025
Douglas on Claude 4: Coding, Agents, and the Future of AI
Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context is underhyped: it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence; fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability—not capability—the bar for agents.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向强化学习：可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

views.en: RL is a new scaling axis; coding is the leading indicator, and long agentic coherence plus inference compute will bottleneck progress by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为：强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，编程是领先指标，长时程智能体式连贯性与推理算力将在 2028 年前成为瓶颈。

views.en: Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed, and world models are not on the critical path—coding and AI research are the direct route.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持：Transformer 足以通向 AGI，无需新架构；世界模型不在关键路径上，编程与 AI 研究才是直接路线。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents, with compute as the new oil and chip supply the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向落地：能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要，工作变成管理智能体集群，算力是新石油、芯片供应是瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

episodes.tEn: Inside China's AI Labs: Nathan Lambert on Open Models, Compute Constraints, and US-China Divergence
Open Models as the Engine for the Next Decade of AI Research
AI State of the Art: DeepSeek, Claude Opus 4.5, and the Global Race
AI2 Launches Fully Open Almo 3 Models, Challenging Closed-Source AI
Post-Training Recipes and RLVR with Nathan Lambert
Tulu 3: Open Source Post-Training for LLMs
AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning dominate; safety is system-level, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业垄断。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR unlocks reasoning.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 三阶段，强调数据质量胜过算法选择，RLVR 能解锁推理与思维链行为。

views.en: Open-source post-training can match frontier models; overoptimization plagues RL, RLHF and RLVR alike.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张开源后训练可匹敌前沿模型，同时指出过度优化在强化学习、RLHF 与 RLVR 中普遍存在，模型会钻最简单信号的漏洞。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理侧 Scaling。

views.en: Open models become the engine of AI research; Chinese labs lead openness, yet lag 6-9 months behind frontier.
views.zh: 2026 年，他视开放模型为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，中国实验室以战略开放主导生态，但前沿模型仍落后 6 至 9 个月，且差距可能扩大。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

episodes.tEn: Alexander Wang on Founding Scale at 19
Meta's AI Journey: From Llama 4 to Muse Spark and Beyond
Alex Wang on Meta's AI Strategy and New Model Release
AI's Acceleration: From Pre-training to Recursive Self-Improvement
Alex Wang on Neuralink, AI, and the Future of Humanity
From Squiggle to Scale: Alex's Founder Journey
Alexander Wang on Data as the New Code and the Future of AI
Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; scaling is limited by data and expert post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来 2-3 年将决定全球未来二三十年；Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据做后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement begins beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，质疑收益递减是错的；AI 是中心化而非民主化技术；智能体终于真正可用，并进入超越预训练与强化学习的递归自我改进新范式。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL across axes; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; build personal superintelligence for billions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张：超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据、强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling（规模扩张）；开源强大模型不安全，应选择性发布；目标是让数十亿人拥有个人超级智能。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; latent demand is the top product principle.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求是最重要的产品原则。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved; the 'software engineer' title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步断言：编码已基本被解决，'软件工程师'头衔将淡出，演变为跨学科的'构建者'角色。

views.en: Scaffolding is temporary tech debt; delete system prompts and code with each new model via ablation.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化方法论：脚手架只是临时技术债；每出新模型就通过消融实验删掉大部分系统提示与代码。

views.en: Loops are the next abstraction layer after agents; humans direct AI agents rather than write code.
views.zh: 2026 年他把抽象层级推进到智能体之后：循环是下一层抽象，人类负责指挥 AI 智能体而非亲手写代码。

views.en: Safety and alignment are core, not afterthoughts; release early to study real-world model behavior.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对齐与安全是核心而非事后补丁，通过尽早发布来研究模型在真实世界中的行为。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张 PM 应放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的技能。

views.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability; 95% is not enough for real leverage, and simple setups beat over-customized workflows.
views.zh: 同期他强调自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不足以产生真正杠杆；简单配置往往胜过过度定制的 AI 工作流。

views.en: Safe AGI as a mission unifies Anthropic, enabling fast cross-org decisions and autonomous teams guided by clear goals.
views.zh: 他仍以安全 AGI 为统一使命，让 Anthropic 能快速跨组织决策，并让团队在清晰目标下自主行动。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs internally.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注产品品味；Claude Tag 内部已承担 65% 的产品 PR。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, and rewrites are now safe with good evals.
views.zh: 同期他深化立场：前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%；有了好的评测套件，重写代码库也变得安全。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Claude Code: Mods, Mutable Software, and Multiplayer Agents — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang means we must delete old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 模型比我们的工具链更聪明；能力过剩意味着随着模型进步，必须删掉旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；要在实现前找到未知项。

views.en: Leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules; smarter models need fewer instructions and examples.
views.zh: 更精简、原则驱动的提示胜过详细规则；更聪明的模型需要更少的指令和示例。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩。

views.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
views.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是技术问题。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Early 2026: leadership lessons from Microsoft to Meta—dogfooding, trust-and-verify, kindness as strategy, and mission alignment drive team speed.
views.zh: 2026 年初：从微软到 Meta 的领导力经验——吃自己的狗粮、信任并验证、把善意当作战略、以使命对齐驱动团队速度。

views.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and code becomes source of truth.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时化，代码成为唯一事实来源。

views.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs, fuzzy code ownership, and killing stale processes replace traditional structure.
views.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织、模糊的代码归属、砍掉过时流程，取代传统结构。

views.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and just-in-time planning matter most.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架、即时化规划最为关键。

views.en: Across 2026, a consistent thread: AI lifts everyone's ceiling, so outcomes beat output, and roles blur as PMs ship code and engineers work with agents.
views.zh: 贯穿 2026 年的一条主线：AI 抬高了每个人的上限，因此结果胜过产出，角色边界模糊——产品经理写代码，工程师与智能体协作。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进步需算法创新，并将推理时算力视为新的扩展轴。

views.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
views.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型不变的核心。

views.en: Tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为搜索、代码执行等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会令模型困惑。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立，但需指数级算力；持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training RL remains a green field.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练强化学习仍是广阔蓝海。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。
